chosen.title: How To Do A KETTLEBELL RUSSIAN TWIST | Exercise Demonstration Video and Guide
chosen.description:
The Kettlebell Russian Twist is an excellent core strengthening exercise that primarily targets the obliques. To get started:
1. Sit down on the ground, while holding a kettlebell by the horns, with your arms in front of your body.
2. With your knees slightly bent, raise your feet a few inches off the ground, keeping your core contracted, and back flat.
3. Under control, slowly bring the kettlebell towards your hip on one side of your body, then reverse the movement to the other side of your body.
4. Continue for reps.

Avoid This Russian Twist Mistake #abs
candidates.description: Russian twist is that one ab exercise that no one gets it right from the first time. A common mistake is to focus on tapping the floor left and right without actually rotating your core and engaging your obliques. Instead, focus on driving your elbows back behind your body to ensure rotation and full contraction in your obliques.
